method: Read-only SHA256 comparison of current project package files against original downloaded asset packages, including byte-preserving aliases traced to original sources.

coverage.scope: Only source package files explicitly present in the provided RequiredAssetClosure snapshot. The study-authored assets and level are excluded from source hash comparison.
coverage.limitation: The source comparison covers the supplied snapshot, including source packages referenced through its eleven authored-material entries. Supplemental read-only byte-string inspection of those authored files found zero existing external package paths absent from the snapshot. Byte strings may include metadata, and no Unreal AssetRegistry/material graph traversal was repeated here; this check does not independently prove a complete derived-material dependency graph.
